question: What rules and numbers do the defibrillator, EIDOS, MPAPS, mobile jammer, drone and other tool gadget graphs hold?

sourceFacts.method: Compiled expression graphs were listed with expression-graphs/exgraph.py (format from L4016, names from L4017 and L4019) and read section by section by a delegated reader; each constant cited here was then checked at its raw offset in the resource file. Full reading: expression-graphs/findings/gadgets-tools-misc.md.

control.description: Every cited constant is a raw-offset check against the resource body. Function meanings marked inferred in the findings file are not relied on for the checked values.

points: Defibrillator (`SimEx_Defib`): charge time = clamp(`TimeToFullCharge` - `ActiveReviveTimeReduction`, `ChargeTimeMinimum`, `TimeToFullCharge`). Effects: `Affector_Damage_Defibrillator` parameter 0.5, `AffectorRevive_Defibrillator_Ranked` parameter 2.0 (entry 6 when the action enum is 24), `Affector_Supercharge` parameter 5.0 when an upgrade test passes. Search radius is the larger of the friendly and enemy range tunables.

EIDOS (`SimEx_EIDOS_Logic_GameVolume`): alive time = `EIDOS_Alive Timer` + `PerimeterDefenseTimerExtension` (upgrade only); ends when the timer completes or intercepts reach `EIDOS_Max Intercepts` + `PerimeterDefenseProjectileAddition` (upgrade only); intercept search every 0.1 s within `EIDOS_Max Intercept Range`. MPAPS has the same structure with its own tunables.
Mobile jammer: radius x `ImprovedJammerRadiusMulti` with the upgrade; jam, lock-jam and projectile-jam effects applied with parameter 0.2; self-jam uses `JammingDuration_Self`.
Drone out-of-bounds timer: rises at 1 x and decays at 2 x frame time, capped at `Drone_Max Time Out Of Bounds`, checked every 0.25 s.
Adrenaline shot: three self effects (flak, suppression, debuff removal) all take `AdrenalineShot_Duration`.
Gas mask, TUGS, laser designator, repair tool, deployable cover, Lancet and tracer dart are described in the findings file; those rows are a delegated reading and not individually raw-checked.

inference: `b569d9f2` reads as a test that the owner has an upgrade; it gates every upgrade tunable seen.

In `ApplyAffector` the first argument reads as the affected entity and the second as the instigator (from repair tool, jammer and defibrillator use); NOTATION.md lists them the other way round and is corrected.
The 0.2 jammer parameter is probably a refresh duration.
unresolved: Tunable values are named here but stored elsewhere.
Defibrillator and Lancet targeting geometry and the laser designator state machine are only partly decoded.
Which branch of the drone timer means out of bounds is inferred.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: Tool and miscellaneous gadget graphs read: defibrillator charge time is the full-charge tunable minus the active-revive reduction with a minimum, its effects use parameters 0.5, 2.0 and 5.0, EIDOS ends on its alive timer or intercept cap and searches every 0.1 s, and the mobile jammer pulses 0.2 effects
leads.summary: The tool and miscellaneous gadget graphs were read. Almost every number is an imported tunable; the graphs hold the rules. Defibrillator charge time = clamp(TimeToFullCharge - ActiveReviveTimeReduction, ChargeTimeMinimum, TimeToFullCharge); its damage, ranked revive and supercharge effects take parameters 0.5, 2.0 and 5.0. EIDOS lasts for its alive timer plus an upgrade extension, or until its intercept cap, and searches every 0.1 s. The mobile jammer applies its effects with parameter 0.2 and its radius is multiplied by an upgrade tunable. 10 raw-offset checks matched.
